# SGEN — Dental Local SEO + AEO

> Local SEO and AEO for dental practices: rank in Google Maps and get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. One monthly retainer from $497, month-to-month, no setup fees.

SGEN builds and ranks dental practice websites for both traditional search (Google search and Google Maps) and answer engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude). Work is delivered as a single monthly retainer with no setup fee and no long-term contract.

## Pages
- [Dental Local SEO + AEO](https://www.sgen.com/dental-local-seo-aeo): the dental vertical landing page — method, pricing, proof and FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO Only — $497/month
- Local AEO (Accelerate) — $797/month
- Local SEO + AEO (Authority) — $1,297/month
All plans are billed monthly through Stripe, cancellable at any time, with no setup or kickoff fees.

## Method
A six-step system: audit and baseline, technical foundation, on-page and entity work, local surface (Google Business Profile, citations, reviews), answer-engine optimisation, then reporting and iteration.

## Specialties served
General and family dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and teeth whitening, orthodontics, pediatric dentistry, endodontics, dental implants, periodontics, oral surgery, prosthodontics, emergency dental care.

## Key answers
- How long does it take? Local SEO typically moves in 60–120 days; AEO mentions can appear in 30–60 days.
- Can I cancel? Yes — monthly billing through Stripe, cancel in the customer portal, no exit fee.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization: getting cited by AI assistants, as distinct from ranking in Google.
- Is there a contract? No. Month-to-month.

## Pricing detail
- Local SEO Only — $497/month. Google Business Profile optimisation, citation building and cleanup,
  on-page local SEO, monthly reporting.
- Local AEO (Accelerate) — $797/month. Everything in Local SEO Only, plus answer-engine optimisation:
  entity and schema work, prompt tracking across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude.
- Local SEO + AEO (Authority) — $1,297/month. Both engines run together, with content production
  and link acquisition on top.
All plans are month-to-month, billed through Stripe, cancellable in the customer portal, no setup
or exit fees. Cancelling leaves every page, post, citation and link already built in the client's hands.

## Method detail
1. Audit and baseline — technical crawl, Google Business Profile audit, citation audit, competitor set.
2. Technical foundation — crawlability, speed, schema, mobile.
3. On-page and entity work — service pages, internal linking, entity consistency.
4. Local surface — Google Business Profile, citations, review velocity.
5. Answer-engine optimisation — structured answers, entity grounding, prompt tracking.
6. Reporting and iteration — monthly reporting against baseline.

## Timeline
- Day 0: subscribe, instant receipt.
- Same day: 90-second application; senior strategist reviews before any call.
- Within 24 hours: dedicated point of contact sends the 30-day plan, baseline audit and prompt-tracking list.
- Within 7 days: first deliverables live — Google Business Profile fixes, schema, citations, first content drop.

## What is not offered
- No long-term contracts, no setup fees, no exit fees.
- No guaranteed rankings. Local SEO typically moves in 60-120 days; AEO mentions in 30-60 days.
